hadith.en: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger. Reported by al-Bukhari.
hadith.tr: Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem buyurdu: Gerçek babayiğit, güreşte rakibini yenen değil, öfkelendiği zaman nefsine hâkim olandır. Buhârî rivayet etmiştir.

explain1.en: Shaykh Ibn Baz, may Allah have mercy on him, explained: When the Prophet, peace be upon him, saw a man who was intensely angry, he said: I know a word that, if he were to say it, what he is experiencing would go away: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan.
explain1.tr: Şeyh İbn Baz, Allah ona rahmet etsin, şöyle açıkladı: Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem, öfkesi şiddetlenen bir adamı görünce şöyle buyurdu: Öyle bir söz biliyorum ki, eğer onu söylerse kendisinden bu hal gider. Eğer Şeytan'dan Allah'a sığınırım derse, kendisinden bu hal gider.

explain2.en: And he said: Do not be hasty in acting upon your anger, and beware of its causes: by leaving the gathering, by occupying yourself with the prescribed wudu, by reading the Quran.
explain2.tr: Ve şöyle dedi: Öfkeni uygulamakta acele etme ve sebeplerinden sakın: bulunduğun meclisten kalkarak, abdest almakla meşgul olarak, Kur'an okuyarak.

close.en: Share it, and may Allah accept your deeds.
